title: ffsubsync-run-log
description: Minimum provenance record for one ffsubsync invocation. Write on every run, including failures. Schema version: 1.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of invocation start.

command.description: Exact argv passed to ffsubsync, including all flags.

status.description: success = output file written; skipped_low_quality = --skip-sync-on-low-quality triggered (no output); error = non-zero exit for another reason.

output_path.description: Absolute path to written SRT. Present only when status=success.

stderr_excerpt.description: First 500 characters of stderr, for triage.

split_penalty_used.description: True when --split-penalty was passed. Flag as requiring manual review per contract.

source_record.description: Veyrul record ID and revision that described the workflow used. E.g. art_01M6N3Y4A4RTHK7PKXE3ZWES7K r3.

contract_artifact.description: Lab artifact ID of the integration contract this run follows. E.g. 45a47cac-1846-48d9-8e1a-38dec3067699.
